_comment: F11 (The Tree) measured against the nine DoD bars AS WRITTEN (item 2 = enumerated; residuals = explicitly bounded), per engineering-specs/phase4-measurement-standard-ruling.md. Judgments authored; every fact derived from a pinned artifact at run time. Regenerate: tools/phase4_f11_written_bar_assessment.py
row_name: Stage 11 The Tree: scouts/Dot, climbing, acorns, swinging

standard.item2_bar: enumerated, scoped to relevant (NOT empty unresolved set)
standard.vocabulary: bounded-exhausted remains a stop decision and never reads as met; this assessment publishes measurement, not disposition
standard.multi_mechanism_rule: F11 names four mechanics. A result proved for one is not credited across the row; see per_mechanism

authority.author_conflict: the assessor is not the author of F11's evidence, but is the author of this measurement and of the census it carries durable_evidence forward from; no state here is a promotion and met_candidate is a submission, not a met

facts.climb_artifact_verdict: CLIMBING MAY BE DISCRETE: the state word took value(s) [3] outside the documented domain [0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6] -- investigate those.
facts.collide_declared_context: Training overlay loaded (LEVEL07/LEVEL1.BIN @ 0x800B39A0). Range holds for THIS overlay: observed 2 and 13 in the two pristine fixtures, and the field indexes a 14-arm dispatch table at 0x800B39A4 whose span equals the range span. ⚠️ THE ADDRESS IS NOT UNIQUE. Overlay-local VAs are keyed globally here with no image field, and 0x800B4A3C is also real written state in LEVEL02_LEVEL1.BIN (3 refs, 2 stores), which routes via the progression table to F11_the_tree -- where it was measured at 0..320 over 1,896 writes, far outside this range. Three rows have now collided on this entry (E07 / F00 / F11). The range is scoped to the training overlay and must not be read as a property of the address.
movie_queue_reasons: no associated movie under case-sensitive movies/Phase4/

durable_evidence.basis: CARRIED FORWARD from the measured F-row census, not re-derived: 8/8 declared fixtures intact -- each exists, is centrally pinned and byte-matches its pin. 9 row-named analysis artifacts (plus 1 shared) and 30 row tests are git-tracked and the C pinner recompiles and passes today (27/27)
durable_evidence.gap: the fixture SET is intact but is not the evidence base: 0 of the 2 operator recordings that carry every runtime finding on this row are declared row fixtures (both are pinned elsewhere and byte-match: 2/2). And 0 of 8 artifacts record a movie hash, so the 2026-08-05 start-state backfill rewrote both movie files after the 2026-08-04 artifacts were produced with nothing able to detect it. Not a re-measurement -- a named residual on a met dimension

original_oracle.written_bar: behavior asserted against the ORIGINAL game's own natural execution, not injected state
original_oracle.basis: the runtime evidence IS natural and uninjected: two operator recordings, watch-only, no poke or perturbation in any artifact, ring not truncated in the two headline runs (gate False, find False) across 12107 and 4605 frames. The acorn retirement was registered as a FALSIFIABLE prediction before the run (True) and confirmed (10 retirements, +0x62 taking only [5]), which is the strongest oracle-shaped act on the row
original_oracle.gap: no cold boot: 0 of 2 recordings are from_boot, 2 are reproducible_only_from_state and 2 carry a BACKFILLED start-state hash (no recording-time binding exists). NO NEGATIVE CONTROL for the row's headline claim -- the gate's refusal path (fewer than five scouts touching Dot) is never exercised in evidence; only the satisfied path is. 0 of 8 artifacts record the disc, binary or execution mode they were taken on (A16 does: True), and the workbench still lists 5 oracle layers missing

complete_frontier.written_bar: item 2 AS WRITTEN: callers/callees/callbacks/indirect tables ENUMERATED, scoped to relevant, residual explicitly bounded -- not an empty unresolved set
complete_frontier.basis: one surface is genuinely ENUMERATED and closed: the stage overlay's absolute-global store set, 0x800B4A24..0x800B4A4C (11 words), from a dataflow scan of the blob, every one exercised live (0 silent) and 2 named. The stage actor roster is enumerated too (57 actors / 10 species in scene 12), and the scout set and stride were read off the counting loop rather than assumed. 27/27 static pins hold against the blob the row PROVED resident
complete_frontier.gap: the enumeration is per-surface, not per-row, and no residual is declared -- the item-2 bounding mechanism F01 used is not carried here. The ownership graph lists 38 state addresses 'cited with no semantic-registry owner' and no named obstruction; 8 of the stage's 10 species are unidentified in the census artifact itself. The retained writer set in the climbing artifact is TOP-8 TRUNCATED, so of the 10 writer sites the row's prose enumerates as the COMPLETE map, 2 (['0x800486b4', '0x80048cfc']) cannot be checked against the registered evidence -- including ['0x80048cfc'], the only site the prose credits with state 3, of which 0 appears in the retained set even though state 3 is observed. Same shape in the save diff (40 of 59 candidates retained). Nothing is enumerated for swinging

typed_state.written_bar: state fields typed and value domains bounded (enumerating an untyped residual bounds the WORKLIST, not the STATE)
typed_state.basis: all 11 overlay words carry a MEASURED domain (writes, distinct values, min/max, writer PCs); the scout counter's domain is closed by its DERIVATION (walk [6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0], publish = 5 - found) rather than observed alone, which is the one field on this row that is typed rather than merely bounded
typed_state.gap: only 2 of 11 overlay words are LABELLED in the artifact -- the other 9 characterisations (found-scout ordinal, found-actor pointer, two angle accumulators, three countdown timers, a mode word, a ramp) live only in prose and are not machine-checked by anything. 6 of 12 state addresses this row cites have no semantic-registry owner. Worse, one of the 6 that DO is mis-scoped: 0x800B4A3C is credited to this row as original.training_step (kind overlay_field, owner original_game.training_overlay, declared range max 13 in context 'Training overlay loaded (LEVEL07/LEVEL1.BIN @ 0x800B39A0). Range holds for THIS overlay: observed 2 and 13 in the two pristine fixtures, and the field indexes a 14-arm dispatch table at 0x800B39A4 whose span equals the range span. ⚠️ THE ADDRESS IS NOT UNIQUE. Overlay-local VAs are keyed globally here with no image field, and 0x800B4A3C is also real written state in LEVEL02_LEVEL1.BIN (3 refs, 2 stores), which routes via the progression table to F11_the_tree -- where it was measured at 0..320 over 1,896 writes, far outside this range. Three rows have now collided on this entry (E07 / F00 / F11). The range is scoped to the training overlay and must not be read as a property of the address.'), while F11's own measurement of that address in a DIFFERENT resident blob is 0..320 over 1896 writes. Overlay-local addresses are keyed globally, so the registry types the ADDRESS, not the field, and F11's typed count is inflated by one. The acorn record fields (+0x5A/+0x62/+0x6E) are observed but not typed: only the retirement value [5] is explained

lifecycle.written_bar: cold boot / load / first use / repeated use / exhaustion / retirement / reuse each evidenced
lifecycle.basis: ACORNS carry a near-complete arc and it is the row's best result: marked by overlay ['0x800b41a4'] -> leaves the live actor table -> retired -> re-initialised by ['0x80049cac'] -> reused, with REPEATED use measured (10 marks and 10 clears across 6 of 7 acorns, 10 retirements over 6 of them). SCOUTS get load+init (the 4605-frame recording starts before the level load), first use, repeated use (5 finds) and persistence (0 clears); Dot's bit is the one-shot consumed per touch
lifecycle.gap: NOT CREDITED ACROSS THE ROW. Cold boot is absent for every mechanism (0 from-boot recordings); exhaustion is never argued or marked n/a-with-reason. Climbing contributes no lifecycle at all -- its single result is a bounded NEGATIVE on the player state word -- and ['swinging'] has no F11 artifact of any kind. No per-phase claim map artifact exists for F11 -- the acorn arc is reconstructed from prose across two artifacts, not registered as a phase-by-phase map the way F01's is

cross_system_behavior.written_bar: native combinations exercised (carry+damage, powers+jump, projectiles at transitions, enemies vs hazards/plants)
cross_system_behavior.basis: exactly ONE combination is measured end to end inside a single natural run: player contact (resident resolver ['0x8004b464']) x overlay scout counter x cinematic camera x per-count sfx table x objective latch (set by ['0x800b4424']) x scene transition, over 12107 frames and 33813 events
cross_system_behavior.gap: the four mechanics were only ever watched SEPARATELY -- each artifact carries its own watch set and no artifact crosses two of them, so nothing tests acorns during a find, climbing under any of it, or swinging at all. The sharpest omission is that the acorn's OTHER role is a DIFFERENT ROW's result: E10's acorn_l11 fixture measures the same stage's acorn as a DAMAGE PRODUCER (caller 0x8004B4A0, 661 records, movie 428 health 1->0; movie 548 health 0->-1) and F11's prose never cites it (mentions_producer=False). 'Reusable prop, counted by nothing' is therefore half the acorn: it is also this stage's rolling hazard, and prop-state x damage was never joined. No combination matrix is registered

original_interfaces.written_bar: interfaces documented; unknowns enumerated WITH named obstructions
original_interfaces.basis: the overlay->resident call interface is documented at instruction level with argument evidence and machine-checked: 27/27 pins hold, covering the cinematic-camera call and its flags argument, play_sound, sfx_dispatch fed from a per-count byte table, the cinematic-camera flags read, the actor-record offsets and the shared live actor table. The ownership graph enumerates 6 reader and 6 writer groups over 56 functions and 16 assets
original_interfaces.gap: no interface/ABI ledger artifact exists for this row, so argument DOMAINS are undocumented, and the 38 enumerated unknowns carry no named obstruction -- the written bar asks for both halves. An unresolved NAMING conflict sits on the row's most-cited call: the derived function census calls 0x8004da94 'level_complete_finale' while F11's own evidence (a scout find is not a level completion) and Canon SYS_cinematic_camera call it the cinematic-camera start. The same census still resolves this row's overlay functions against ['MEMORY', 'overlay:ambiguous'] -- the LEVEL03_* naming this row's own binding falsified by a 100.0% code-window match to LEVEL02/LEVEL1.BIN

source_closure.written_bar: byte-matched C through the original toolchain for the row's governing functions
source_closure.basis: measured against the row's own governing set: of 12 unique functions the campaign inventory attributes to F11, decompilation status is {'asm': 7, 'c': 1, 'missing': 4} -- 1 carries C (scene_setup_and_load, a shared resident function owned by another row) and the 4 overlay-local functions that contain every F11 mechanism are absent from the index entirely. F11 has produced no source
source_closure.gap: the F-row census reported this dimension as 'measurable: source/build entries exist (resident and/or overlay track)' on 0 segments entry. That is a SUBSTRING ARTIFACT, verified here by re-running the census's own regex: the only match for stem 'f11' is ['asm/hand_written/8005f110_sub_8005f110.s'], i.e. the hex address, not an F11 surface (address_substring=True). Closing this needs the overlay functions indexed against the CORRECT blob first

campaign_breadth.written_bar: conclusions generalize across every applicable stage -- which requires the applicable set itself to be enumerated
campaign_breadth.basis: the row's one campaign-wide generalisation was FALSIFIED INSIDE THE ROW: 'bit 0x1000 = the player has contacted me, campaign-wide' was retracted to a shared scratch flag by this row's own acorn evidence (setter ['0x800b41a4'] is overlay code on the acorn's own predicate, not the contact resolver ['0x8004b464']). Evidence covers exactly one stage (scene 12, scene_ids_uniform=True across 5 saves) from 2 recordings
campaign_breadth.gap: the applicability universe is not enumerated -- which stages have a finder objective, reusable props, or vertical traversal is nowhere declared, so 'every applicable stage' has no denominator. The one claim from this row that did generalise (asset-graph name != resident blob) was generalised by ANOTHER row's arithmetic rule, which is not this row meeting the bar. This fails the WRITTEN bar, not only the strict one

states_considered_and_not_used.met_candidate: NONE. Nothing on this row is currently submittable for promotion: every dimension short of met has a gap that is a missing measurement, not a pending adjudication. The closest is lifecycle (the acorn arc), which fails only because cold boot and a registered per-phase claim map are absent.
states_considered_and_not_used.unmeasured: NONE, and this was checked rather than assumed. Every dimension has at least some F11 evidence bearing on its bar, so 'unmeasured' would understate what exists. The row-level absence is per-MECHANISM, not per-dimension: swinging has no F11 artifact at all and is recorded that way in per_mechanism, where it belongs, instead of being spread across nine cells.
